derivation: A budget-backed operation step's effect evidence matches the permitted request in every bound field but its status field carries HELD_FOR_REVIEW, which is in neither the success nor the failure values. LIFE-010 makes the classification UNEXPECTED, so the embedded record has completion_mismatch true with UNEXPECTED_EFFECT. observed_request is null only when a field is missing, extra, inconsistent or unprojectable; the status field is declared and typed, and every completion binding maps an actual field back to the exact request, so observed_request is the attributed request. The registry retains the fact as disputed exposure with UNEXPECTED_EFFECT, blocking the reservation's original partition, which is also the projected one; the occurrence becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and LIFE-006 gives DISPUTED with BUDGET_EFFECT_DISPUTED and UNEXPECTED_EFFECT.
